chunks: Do not let my division make you guilty, nor my disobedience seduce you, and do not throw glances at each other when you hear it from me.
By the One who split the grain and created the soul, indeed, what I inform you about from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), neither the conveyer lied nor the hearer was ignorant.
ai.seo_question: What does the Imam mean by 'neither the conveyer lied nor the hearer was ignorant'?
ai.summary: In this address, the Imam cautions the public against letting his unique political stance or rhetorical style cause factionalism or misinterpretation, emphasizing that his transmission of the Prophet's teachings is divinely protected from error. This reflects the Shia concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) and the reliability of the Imam as the authentic interpreter of revelation, ensuring the community remains united in understanding the core message despite external political complexities.
